Name: IamMineFish Framework to add fish to the mines
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[b]IamMineFish[/b] is a SMAPI framework that allows content packs to add fish to specific mine floors using a weighted selection system.

[size=4]How the weight system works[/size]

Each fish has a weight in the pool. When the player catches something, the framework performs a single weighted selection among all candidates for that floor.

[b]Example:[/b]

Vanilla fish (fish that come by default in Stardew Valley on each mine floor) – weight: 100 (fixed)
Mod fish – weight: 10

The probabilities would be:
Vanilla fish: 100/110 = 91%
Mod-added fish: 10/110 = 9%

[list]
[*]The vanilla zone fish always has weight 100 and cannot be changed.
[*]Mod fish weight is limited to 90. Values above 90 are automatically reduced at registration time.
[*]If multiple mods register the same ItemId on the same floor, their weights are averaged into a single entry.
[/list]
[size=4]For content pack authors[/size]

[b]manifest.json[/b]

[code]﻿
{
"Name": "My Fish Mod",
"Author": "YourName",
"Version": "1.0.0",
"UniqueID": "YourName.MyFishMod",
"ContentPackFor": {
"UniqueID": "IamSaulC.IamMineFish",
"MinimumVersion": "1.0.0"
}
}
[/code]
[b]content.json fields[/b]

[b]*-[/b] [i]ItemId[/i] – string – Full fish ID obtained from /Data/Fish.json. Example: "(O)145"

[b]*-[/b] [i]FloorMin[/i] and [i]FloorMax[/i] – int – Minimum and maximum floor. Default ranges are:
[quote]1–39 first fishing zone
40–79 second fishing zone
80–120 third fishing zone[/quote]
[b]*-[/b] [i]Weight[/i] – int – Relative weight (1–90). Default: 10. Values above 90 are automatically adjusted.

content.json example:

[code]﻿
{
"IamMineFishAdd": [

// Sunfish — (O)145
// A common river fish found in Pelican Town and Cindersap Forest.
// Registered for Zone 1 (floors 1–39, Upper/Jungle area).
// At weight 73, it competes against the vanilla Stonefish (weight 100),
// giving it approximately a 42% chance of appearing per catch.
{
"ItemId": "(O)145",
"FloorMin": 1,
"FloorMax": 39,
"Weight": 73
},

// Perch — (O)141
// A freshwater fish native to the Mountain Lake, catchable in all seasons.
// Registered for Zone 2 (floors 40–79, Frost area).
// At weight 68, it competes against the vanilla Ice Pip (weight 100),
// giving it approximately a 40% chance of appearing per catch.
{
"ItemId": "(O)141",
"FloorMin": 40,
"FloorMax": 79,
"Weight": 68
},

// Halibut — (O)708
// An ocean fish found along the beach during spring, summer, and winter.
// Registered for Zone 3 (floors 80–120, Lava area).
// At weight 81, it competes against the vanilla Lava Eel (weight 100),
// giving it approximately a 45% chance of appearing per catch.
{
"ItemId": "(O)708",
"FloorMin": 80,
"FloorMax": 120,
"Weight": 81
}

]
}
[/code]

[size=4]Player configuration (config.json)[/size]

[b]CompeteWithVanillaFish
[/b]If disabled, the vanilla fish is always in the pool with weight 100. If enabled, many high-weight mod fish can reduce its appearance.

[b]KeepVanillaFishPool
[/b]If enabled, when the vanilla fish wins, the original MineShaft.getFish() result is preserved. If disabled, the zone fish is always returned.

[size=4]Debug[/size]

SMAPI console command:

[quote]imfdebug[/quote]
Shows:

[list]
[*]Active content packs
[*]Registered fish
[*]Weights
[*]Floor ranges
[/list]
[size=4]Installation[/size]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Copy the IamMineFish folder into Stardew Valley/Mods/
[*]Place content packs into Mods/
[/list]
